note: A server without groups and times shows the older page; older sent messages have no time or group
The member's inbox must show it and lose it on take back; the Sent list on a second device is up to 2 minutes old
No app members: 'No member has the app yet. Members who join in the next 14 days will see it. Send now?'; typing is cut 20 and 60 letters past the limits
One offer a day turns over at midnight; a later time is typed in the browser's own clock
Take back has no busy state; the 'already sent' mark lives only on the open page, so a reload offers the same words again
The message has its own English / Hindi switch; a member with pop-ups off still gets it in the inbox ('No phone pop-up')
The question, 'Yes, send' and 'Not yet' sit on one wrapping line
